summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an attached news release announcing the filing of an updated NI 43-101 Technical Report for the Ying Mining District in China. The report, prepared by AMC Mining Consultants (Canada) Ltd., covers mineral reserves and resources with an effective date of December 31, 2025. There are no material differences from the previously disclosed information. This is a routine disclosure by a foreign private issuer regarding technical report updates. No special situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or management change, is present. The filing is purely informational and not a special situation. Thus, it is classified as 'None'.
